_olotro_: Day 8: Ulrich Olotro reached R-S16 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Ulrich Olotro and Teodor Shadowizard carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.

Dawn watch. Ulrich Olotro put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Arno "Doc" Jameson, badly wounded. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ulrich Olotro could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Ulrich Olotro won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in R-S16. The lance corporal wants a rematch. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ulrich Olotro is number 584. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-S16 changed before the cheering ended. Ulrich Olotro shouldered another load.
Ulrich Olotro found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Ulrich Olotro asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Ulrich Olotro was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S16. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Florian Marks of the Concord (@marks89kk).
Ulrich Olotro's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-S16 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Rematch. Ulrich Olotro lost everything he won, plus a pressed cornflower. The whole dugout watched.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Ulrich Olotro won back a pressed cornflower and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.
beniiioz: Albin "Parson" Beniiioz unpacked a stub of a pencil at R-R17. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Albin "Parson" Beniiioz before dusk. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin "Parson" Beniiioz made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking. A letter from home reached Albin "Parson" Beniiioz before dusk. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz read it twice and slept a little easier. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 999. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Albin "Parson" Beniiioz helped stack spare sandbags at R-R17. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Pavel Robertopropa pulled Albin "Parson" Beniiioz out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. Now serving as a stretcher bearer, Albin "Parson" Beniiioz discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Albin "Parson" Beniiioz's hands still remember being a medical student's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world. A letter from home reached Albin "Parson" Beniiioz before dusk. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin "Parson" Beniiioz went out with the wiring party at R-R17. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home reached Albin "Parson" Beniiioz before dusk. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin "Parson" Beniiioz found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home reached Albin "Parson" Beniiioz before dusk. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin "Parson" Beniiioz went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Zeno Irl put up a fight, but not for long. (@king_baldwin_irl) The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz fought Teodor Roos in a trench no wider than a door. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz came home with Teodor Roos's cap badge. (@_michael_roos_01) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Albin "Parson" Beniiioz was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Nobody could reach Albin "Parson" Beniiioz in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
The papers connected Jakub Beniiioz to Albin "Parson" Beniiioz. The men took longer to learn Jakub Beniiioz's own habits, but they made the effort.

At R-R17 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Jakub Beniiioz won the bet. Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Jakub Beniiioz before dusk. Jakub Beniiioz read it twice and slept a little easier.
d1etpepsic0la11: The new runner is Isidor "Button" Etpepsic, once a stonemason from Old Harrow. The corporal asked if a stonemason was any use in a trench. Isidor "Button" Etpepsic said he would find out.

Isidor "Button" Etpepsic (Concord) watched Wendel "Mud" Zno (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Calvary Farm, and held fire until both were gone. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Isidor "Button" Etpepsic wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Isidor "Button" Etpepsic worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
A flare caught Isidor "Button" Etpepsic halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
Wiring party. Isidor "Button" Etpepsic held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at U-F19, and everyone came back.
Gideon "Rabbit" Deer pulled Isidor "Button" Etpepsic out of a flooded shell hole at Saint-Ash crossroads. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

Isidor "Button" Etpepsic went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Hegemony trench a man turned around too late. Oskar Blokkhead did not get up again. (@blokkhead2023) No rifles, only shovels and knives. Isidor "Button" Etpepsic dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Dietrich Dbrt coming out. It was over in seconds. (@guerric.dbrt) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Isidor "Button" Etpepsic was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire.
Isidor "Button" Etpepsic is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
denv04: The quartermaster asked Quentin "Hollow" Denv to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Quentin "Hollow" Denv aimed just below it. Henrik Chrisgghill was badly wounded. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Quentin "Hollow" Denv read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Quentin "Hollow" Denv. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.

On a quiet night Quentin "Hollow" Denv (Concord) and Matthias "Saint" Industriousb (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.

Quentin "Hollow" Denv and Albin "Tin" Krut argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Hollow" Denv. Quentin "Hollow" Denv read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Quentin "Hollow" Denv fired at a movement across the wire at U-F11. The man went down: Florian Jthompson, badly wounded.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at U-F11. Quentin "Hollow" Denv was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Otto "Rabbit" Kocibaaaaaaa of the Hegemony (@bbbbbbbbennnn_kocibaaaaaaaa).
Ivo "Button" Denv asked about Quentin "Hollow" Denv on arriving at U-F11. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Fresh from training, Ivo "Button" Denv still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Wendel Elear, gravely wounded.
dill.levi: Gustav Levi unpacked a key to a house that is no longer there at N-F23. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
frvr_midnight: The sergeant gave Gideon "Doc" Midnight a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Gideon "Doc" Midnight listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Gideon "Doc" Midnight fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Norbert Bob was grazed. Victory at Grey Mill. Gideon "Doc" Midnight let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit of the Concord and Gideon "Doc" Midnight of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Drowned Farm for a week. Both trenches keep score.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Ivo "Bones" Camiloalmada's name scratched on it. Gideon "Doc" Midnight kicked it back. It did not come again.
Gideon "Doc" Midnight is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed.

A sniper's bullet hit Gideon "Doc" Midnight at S-R13. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Silas Michigangame of the Concord (@michigangamer). Gideon "Doc" Midnight stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-R13. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Silas Michigangame of the Concord (@michigangamer).
The papers say Zeno Midnight. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Gideon "Doc" Midnight's eyes. Nobody in S-R13 argues.
A bullet clipped Zeno Midnight's helmet at S-R13 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Dietrich Fokai of the Concord (@tru_og_fokai).
Zeno Midnight was hit in the hip at S-R13. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Arno Ricks of the Concord (@sam.ricks).
im_tried_bro: Felix Bro arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in Q-F23 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Felix Bro (Hegemony) watched Marek Zilyox (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Chalk Pits, and held fire until both were gone. Victory at Grey Mill. Felix Bro let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Felix Bro dreamt he was back in Tannenfeld, working as a dance-hall violinist. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
A bullet went through Felix Bro's sleeve at Q-F23 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Gustav Suppahneggah of the Concord (@suppahneggah).
Felix Bro's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
The parcel for Felix Bro contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Felix Bro laughs at exactly the wrong moments. Today, under fire at Sorrow Copse, that habit was the only steady thing in Q-F23.
A newspaper reached Felix Bro with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
jason_birdy27: Emil Birdy came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-R1 with the rations. Emil Birdy ate while listening to the revised orders.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Emil Birdy held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. Grey Mill is lost. Emil Birdy heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Emil Birdy asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
The village shop had three kinds of soap. Emil Birdy stood at the counter far longer than the purchase required.
A recruit asked Emil Birdy how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Emil Birdy (Concord) and Zeno Helldiver (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Ossuary Wood on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
Emil Birdy and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen.

Emil Birdy was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-R1. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Konrad Hammerthyste of the Hegemony (@hammerthysteel).
just_a_second_ago: On Day 11, Konrad Ago arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Konrad Ago shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Konrad Ago put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Casimir Eclark saw Konrad Ago freeze up on the fire step at Lantern Hill. Casimir said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Konrad Ago tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Esterhaus. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Konrad Ago read a theatre review while peeling supper.
Konrad Ago pulled Ivo Time out of a flooded shell hole at Lantern Hill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Konrad Ago taught Nils Oreo three words in the language of home. Nils uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
littlerattae: Day 9: Karel Littlerattae reached Q-F20 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached Q-F20 with the rations. Karel Littlerattae ate while listening to the revised orders.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Karel Littlerattae waited for that to change. When it did, Arno Larpinhimer was grazed. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Karel Littlerattae read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Karel Littlerattae has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.

A bullet found Karel Littlerattae at Q-F20, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Walter Goggles of the Hegemony (@goog_the_bearer_of_goggles). Karel Littlerattae borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Marek "Parson" Adolfdavis was badly wounded. Karel Littlerattae was killed on watch at Q-F20. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Walter Goggles of the Hegemony (@goog_the_bearer_of_goggles).
Oskar Littlerattae joined Q-F20 under the shadow of Karel Littlerattae's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Oskar Littlerattae gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Oskar Littlerattae kept Konrad Arthur awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Oskar could have walked there blind.
Oskar Littlerattae tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear.
A round went through the rim of Oskar Littlerattae's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Arno Larpinhimer of the Hegemony (@larpinhimer1488).
matho_461: Day 11. The corporal put Marek "Lucky" Matho beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Marek "Lucky" Matho mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Marek "Lucky" Matho went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Marek "Lucky" Matho's helmet at N-F7 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low.

Marek "Lucky" Matho returned to N-F7 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. A letter from home found Marek "Lucky" Matho before the night shift. Marek "Lucky" Matho folded it small and kept it close.
Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Marek "Lucky" Matho landed next to Silas Rommosk in the Hegemony trench. Only Marek "Lucky" Matho climbed back out. (@rommosk.11)
Marek "Lucky" Matho drew the street leading to Rosenau. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
micheal.evans09: Leopold Evans came up the line with a pocket Bible with a hole in it and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Isidor "Saint" Michael fell asleep on watch. Leopold Evans took over without waking Saint, and told the sergeant nothing. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In U-F19, Leopold Evans listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at U-F19 and grazed Leopold Evans's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Ivo Oficera of the Hegemony (@od_0_do_oficera).
Leopold Evans's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at U-F19 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Leopold Evans agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Leopold Evans shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Florian Eclecticnerd, was grazed.
A loose thread in Leopold Evans's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
The artist tried again while Leopold Evans read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
red05052: Marek Red left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Coldwater and came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out. The men noticed at once that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.

Marek Red (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Calvary Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. Verdel Ridge has been won. Marek Red listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Marek Red raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F16. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Gideon Allistofeari of the Hegemony (@allistofearisgod).
The medics cleaned Marek Red's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F16.

Marek Red borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. Hill 304 is lost. Marek Red heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Marek Red in the open at R-F16. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies). The bearers reached Marek Red at R-F16 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies).
Rafael "Hollow" Red asked about Marek Red on arriving at R-F16. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Rafael "Hollow" Red found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Rafael "Hollow" Red took the long way round Calvary Farm because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two.

Rafael "Hollow" Red took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-F16, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies).

Rafael "Hollow" Red was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Rafael "Hollow" Red looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The stretcher Rafael "Hollow" Red lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Rafael "Hollow" Red is back at R-F16, and someone else is lying in that dent now. Rafael "Hollow" Red got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 143. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Rafael "Hollow" Red wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh snores. Rafael "Hollow" Red does not. Hollow now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Rafael "Hollow" Red began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
The east wind brought the smell of the other trenches: smoke, lime and somebody's cooking. Rafael "Hollow" Red was hungry and furious about it.
Word of Rafael "Hollow" Red's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.

At R-F16 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Rafael "Hollow" Red turned around and took a shovel blow. Tobias Jeeves of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Tobias Jeeves of the Hegemony (@jeeves2121).
The medic looked at Rafael "Hollow" Red's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F16. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
sus.danny2.0: Day 3. The corporal put Quentin "Shadow" Danny beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Quentin "Shadow" Danny raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F18. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony (@lagbagdotzip). Quentin "Shadow" Danny fired at a movement across the wire at R-F18. The man went down: Lucien Jewnipers, gravely wounded.

Quentin "Shadow" Danny no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet went through Quentin "Shadow" Danny's sleeve at R-F18 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies). Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Quentin "Shadow" Danny watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Quentin "Shadow" Danny is whole again, or near enough for the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Quentin "Shadow" Danny had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll crossed it, Quentin "Shadow" Danny fired. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll was gravely wounded.

Across the wire at Hill 304, Cyril Rotten of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Quentin "Shadow" Danny of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Quentin "Shadow" Danny tried to remember the price of a loaf in Esterhaus. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.

Quentin "Shadow" Danny reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F18 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Edmund "Saint" Nazareth of the Hegemony (@nazareth_2bc). The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Quentin "Shadow" Danny looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medic looked at Quentin "Shadow" Danny's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F18. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin "Shadow" Danny is number 204. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Quentin "Shadow" Danny watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Quentin "Shadow" Danny had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Felix "Ash" Octi, gravely wounded. The men at R-F18 heard Quentin "Shadow" Danny call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus of the Hegemony (@oscizzus). Quentin "Shadow" Danny was killed on watch at R-F18. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus of the Hegemony (@oscizzus).
The papers connected Casimir Danny to Quentin "Shadow" Danny. The men took longer to learn Casimir Danny's own habits, but they made the effort.
A supply man offered Casimir Danny a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.

The trench wall shook against Casimir Danny's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir Danny. Casimir Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Casimir Danny spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Casimir Danny only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F18, then nothing but pain. Raider: Lucien Universal of the Hegemony (@chamra_universal). A letter came for Casimir Danny with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Casimir Danny pinned it to the dugout wall.
The wound Casimir Danny shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more.
the_real_brennan_ware: Norbert Ware reached T-F2 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Listening post, three in the morning. Norbert Ware heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. A letter from home reached Norbert Ware before dusk. Norbert Ware read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill has been won. Norbert Ware listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Norbert Ware was waiting. Bram Landonbuttva was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Norbert Ware before dusk. Norbert Ware read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert Ware moved to a new hide at T-F2 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Marek Triskit, grazed. A letter from home reached Norbert Ware before dusk. Norbert Ware read it twice and slept a little easier.
Norbert Ware traded a frozen apple for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. A letter from home reached Norbert Ware before dusk. Norbert Ware read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert Ware saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Zeno "Shadow" Landonbuttva, was badly wounded. Norbert Ware reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F2 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Tobias Tyleraldridg of the Concord (@tyleraldridge45).

Fever took hold of Norbert Ware overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. A letter for Norbert Ware came with a pressed flower inside. Norbert Ware showed the flower to nobody.

There was never a bed for Norbert Ware, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to T-F2 on his own feet. Norbert Ware read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.
thetexasdoughboy: Quentin Thetexasdoug arrived with the Day 12 draft, carrying a cracked shaving mirror and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it. Quentin Thetexasdoug transferred to the chaplains. The men in V-F18 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Quentin Thetexasdoug watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Thetexasdoug. Quentin Thetexasdoug read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Quentin Thetexasdoug found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Quentin Thetexasdoug borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

Quentin Thetexasdoug snores. Hugo Juggernaut does not. Hugo now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends. A letter reached Quentin Thetexasdoug in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

A bullet found Quentin Thetexasdoug at V-F18, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Karel Dennis of the Hegemony (@dennis._s03). Quentin Thetexasdoug was killed outright at V-F18, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Karel Dennis of the Hegemony (@dennis._s03).
The papers connected Konrad Thetexasdoug to Quentin Thetexasdoug. The men took longer to learn Konrad Thetexasdoug's own habits, but they made the effort.
twenskyyy: Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy came up with a draft of replacements on Day 4. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy thought about an old father who runs the family shop alone on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.

During a lull at the Chalk Pits, Nils Photo called across from the Concord line. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
The cook borrowed Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko and Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Jonas "Doc" Angelogia taught Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 319. The men who came later will ask about it. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy and Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy had just lit a cigarette at R-F22 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Walter Jameson of the Concord (@jameson.308).
Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.

At R-F22 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy turned around and took a shovel blow. Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele of the Concord (@dylansteele71).
Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back.
williamagrah2021: The draft reached N-F13 on Day 12. Hugo Williamagrah was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. The transfer made Hugo Williamagrah a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Hugo Williamagrah wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. A letter from home reached Hugo Williamagrah before dusk. Hugo Williamagrah read it twice and slept a little easier.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Hugo Williamagrah was hit in the forearm at N-F13. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind.

Hugo Williamagrah stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher. A letter from home reached Hugo Williamagrah before dusk. Hugo Williamagrah read it twice and slept a little easier.

Hugo Williamagrah spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to N-F13. A short letter reached Hugo Williamagrah: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Hugo Williamagrah read the part about the dog twice.
Hugo Williamagrah tried to remember the price of a loaf in Ashford Vale. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
